title: The Prefect's Problem
author: Edgar Allan Poe
ciphertext: OFJZNOY PI PY IZF QFJT YPKOGPRPIT EV IZF IZPXM UZPRZ OHIY TEH NI VNHGI.
plaintext: Perhaps it is the very simplicity of the thing which puts you at fault.
epilogue: C. Auguste Dupin says it to the Prefect of the Paris police, who has spent months searching a minister's rooms for a stolen letter. The letter was in a card-rack on the mantelpiece the whole time, in plain view.
